about: The theme pipeline's queue (docs/themes/PIPELINE.md, D31): one theme in its pass at a time. 'active' are the themes in a pass now (theme-pass.sh start refuses another while one is listed; theme-pass.sh done <theme> takes it off). 'queue' is the order after them (the user: Media Center first, 2026-11-14; then Tide; then alphabetical; Orbit then Mosaic moved ahead of Arcade, 2026-11-14). 'done' are complete: Plaza, the reference the checklist was made from (9.59). 'control' would hold themes never refined; none: Baseline is refined too (the stock look drawn by the theme engine; jellyfin-web is its own choice). 'later' are themes held back from the bundle until a later update (D36, 2026-11-16): their packages sit in themes-later/, out of the app and the pipeline; they rejoin the queue when moved back to themes/. 'qa' tracks QA/QC (D40, D41): the phase (A: 3 continuous passes per theme; B: 3 overall rounds), the order, and each theme's current QA pass.
